title: 1081156 Spirit Academy vs LFO 10: the only market was in play and its start differs from Hotspawn's by 25 minutes
detail: Polymarket's official event 1243019 starts this fixture at 2026-10-25T12:25:00Z and quoted Map 1 at 0.999 / 1.000 when read at 13:44Z, while Hotspawn schedules it at 12:00:00Z. The 25-minute gap is outside the 60-second identity window, and an in-play price is never published as a prematch pick, so this fixture carries no prematch probability. HLTV ranks both teams (#111 / #167) but publishes no points, so the ranking rung cannot price it either. Nothing is estimated after the fact.

title: 1082792 HOTU vs The Huns: the published model estimate is 33 points away from the only market observation
detail: Polymarket's Match Winner market 6085308 exists at the same 09:00Z start and displays 65c HOTU / 35c The Huns Esports, but its two-sided book is 0.38 / 0.92 (spread 0.54) and cannot be used as a line. The board publishes 98.2% HOTU from the uncalibrated results-network model. Both figures are labelled: one is an unquotable market, the other is a research model. Precedence between them is a policy question for review, not something this session changes.
